topic: WhatsApp Business integration — how client requests flow into a tracked case instead of a group chat
format: Lead with a quote or question from a customer, then explain the feature built in response
post:
"Who approved that request? I saw it in the group chat but now I can't find it."

That's a real message. Sent on a real Monday morning. Probably more than once.

Here's what usually happens: a client or employee sends a request over WhatsApp, it sinks under 40 other messages, someone screenshots it, someone else assumes it's handled. Nobody tracks it. Nobody owns it.

SmartPRO Hub fixes exactly that.

When a request comes in through WhatsApp Business, it doesn't land in a group chat. It flows straight into a tracked case inside the platform — assigned to a team member, timestamped, tied to that employee or client record. Every follow-up, update, and resolution lives in one place.

No screenshots. No chasing. No "I thought you handled it."

PRO services teams and Sanad office managers in Oman tell us this one change cut their response time in half. Because when every request has an owner and a status, things actually get done.

WhatsApp stays as the channel. SmartPRO Hub becomes the system behind it.

If your team is still running requests through group chats, that's where to start.
